name: Article 3, after § 1 – 187
title: REPORT on the proposal for a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council establishing an EU talent pool
part_text: 1 a. Any participating Member State may decide, at any time, to withdraw its participation in the EU Talent Pool. It shall notify its decision to the Commission with the effective date of withdrawal. From that date, any job vacancies of employers established in that Member State shall be withdrawn from the EU Talent Pool IT platform.
